title: The Smith's Ledger
text: The forge master's ledger lies open on a bench, thick with soot, its pages brittle. Every blade made here is listed in a cramped, careful hand, with the name of the one it was made for. The last entries are written in something darker than ink.

options.label: The wisest reads the ledger to learn what was made here and for whom.

outcomes.text: One blade was made for your House and never collected. The ledger says where it is kept.

options.label: Take the ledger to sell; names are worth something.

outcomes.text: Collectors will pay for it, and so will the families named in it.

options.label: Leave it for whoever comes back.

outcomes.text: No one is coming back. The last entries say why.
